intent.proves: Reverse charge is set on at least one country, VAT group country rate or user.
intent.scope: commerce countries, VAT country rates and users

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomCountries WHERE CountryReverseChargeForVAT = 1) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomVatCountryRelations WHERE VatCountryRelReverseChargeForVat = 1) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser WHERE AccessUserReverseChargeForVat = 1)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
